rationale: Line 1 (97140) denied CO-236 = NCCI PTP edit, with 97150 as the Column One code (paid). The 835 carries neither the partner code nor the Column One/Column Two Indicator (CCMI). Per ncci-ptp-carc-236.md §5/§8, the CCMI for the 97150–97140 pair in the Q3 2026 PTP edit file determines whether a modifier bypass is permitted (CCMI=1) or the denial stands (CCMI=0). Cannot resolve without it.

awaiting_human.question: What is the CCMI (Column One/Column Two Correct Coding Indicator) for the 97150–97140 pair in the CMS NCCI PTP edit file for Q3 2026 (effective 2026-07-01)? It will be 0, 1, or 9.
awaiting_human.why_needed: CCMI=1 means a modifier (59/X-) can bypass the edit and the claim should be corrected and resubmitted via reopening; CCMI=0 means the edit is absolute and the line must be written off. The 835 does not carry this value.
